title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_juana_de_arco_by_50minutos_es_v7mub (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_juana_de_arco_by_50minutos_es_v7mub' contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. Installation of this package results in full system compromise, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is recommended, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets from a different, uncompromised machine due to the risk of persistent malicious software.
